import json
import sys
from dataclasses import fields
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/home/hpcuser/scheduleurm_work/exact_reuse_benchmark_20261001')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from algorithm.arrival_aware_lane_rollout import sample_planning_arrivals
from algorithm.background_competition_continuous_lane_rollout import BackgroundCompetitionContinuousLaneRollout
from algorithm.experiments.aligned_hardware_bg_planning_streams import load_protocol, read, path
from algorithm.experiments.aligned_hardware_performance_necessity import load_models

directory = ROOT / 'md/experiment_artifacts'
protocol = load_protocol(directory)
unit = protocol['units'][462]
trajectory_file = path(directory, '_unit_462_trajectory.json.gz')
saved = read(trajectory_file)
assert saved['registered_at_utc'] == protocol['registered_at_utc']
assert saved['unit'] == unit
fixture = read(directory / unit['fixture_file'])
assert fixture['registered_at_utc'] == protocol['source_execution_epoch']
assert fixture['tape']['tape_id'] == unit['tape_id']
model, = load_models([fixture['model']])
planner = BackgroundCompetitionContinuousLaneRollout(model.options, unit['planning_seed'], 8, 128)
certificates = []
eligible = tagged_events = prefix_draws = prefix_reads = 0

def fraction(value):
    return {'numerator': value.numerator, 'denominator': value.denominator,
            'float': float(value)}

for index, frame in enumerate(saved['result']['frames']):
    info = frame['rollout']
    now, counts = frame['start'], tuple(frame['observed_arrival_counts'])
    rates = tuple(count / now if now else 0.0 for count in counts)
    assert rates == tuple(info['estimated_arrival_rates']), ('rates', index)
    assert counts == tuple(info['observed_arrival_counts']), ('counts', index)
    assert now == info['rate_exposure_s'], ('exposure', index)
    queue = tuple(frame['queue'])
    assert info['eligible'] == (0 < sum(queue) <= model.lanes * planner.batch_width), ('eligible', index)
    paths = []
    if info['eligible']:
        eligible += 1
        assert info['window_s'] == planner.maximum_duration, ('window', index)
        for _ in range(planner.sample_count):
            paths.append(sample_planning_arrivals(rates, planner.maximum_duration, planner.rng, planner.event_cap))
            if paths[-1].overflow:
                break
    assert len(paths) == info['sample_count'], ('sample_count', index)
    path_events = sum(len(path.events) for path in paths)
    path_draws = sum(path.random_draws for path in paths)
    path_reads = sum(path.rate_reads for path in paths)
    assert path_events == info['tagged_planning_events'], ('prefix events', index)
    assert path_draws == info['planning_random_draws'] - info['background_planning_random_draws'], ('prefix draws', index)
    assert path_reads == info['planning_rate_reads'] - info['background_planning_rate_reads'], ('prefix reads', index)
    assert info['planning_events'] == path_events + info['background_planning_events'], ('all events', index)
    assert info['planning_overflow'] == (any(path.overflow for path in paths) or info['background_rollout_overflow']), ('overflow', index)
    tagged_events += path_events
    prefix_draws += path_draws
    prefix_reads += path_reads
    if not (info['changed'] and not info['chosen_predicted_completion_s'] < info['baseline_predicted_completion_s']):
        continue
    assert paths and not info['planning_overflow'], ('changed overflow', index)
    target = BackgroundCompetitionContinuousLaneRollout(model.options, unit['planning_seed'], 8, 128)
    target.arrival_rates, target.decision_counter = rates, index
    lane = frame['lane_ids'][0]
    baseline = target.maxweight(model.options, queue, frame['available_before'], now, lane, frame['waiting_ages'])
    incumbent, = baseline.selection.option_indices
    rng_before = target.rng.getstate()
    scored = target.score_background_roots(queue, frame['available_before'], now, lane, frame['waiting_ages'], paths)
    assert target.rng.getstate() == rng_before, ('target scorer changed prefix RNG', index)
    assert not scored.background_rollout_overflow, ('target scoring overflow', index)
    actual, = frame['option_indices']
    permitted = tuple(root for root in scored.costs if scored.squared_costs[root] <= scored.squared_costs[incumbent])
    ordering = lambda root: (scored.costs[root], root != incumbent, target.durations[root], root)
    chosen = min(permitted, key=ordering)
    unconstrained = min(scored.costs, key=ordering)
    assert actual == chosen, ('actual selected root', index)
    assert actual != incumbent, ('changed root equals incumbent', index)
    assert scored.costs[actual] < scored.costs[incumbent], ('exact S1', index)
    assert scored.squared_costs[actual] <= scored.squared_costs[incumbent], ('exact S2', index)
    rounded = {
        'baseline_predicted_completion_s': float(scored.costs[incumbent] / len(paths)),
        'chosen_predicted_completion_s': float(scored.costs[actual] / len(paths)),
        'baseline_predicted_squared_flow_s2': float(scored.squared_costs[incumbent] / len(paths)),
        'chosen_predicted_squared_flow_s2': float(scored.squared_costs[actual] / len(paths)),
    }
    assert all(info[key] == value for key, value in rounded.items()), ('rounded scores', index)
    expected_work = {field.name: getattr(scored, field.name) for field in fields(scored)
                     if field.name not in ('costs', 'squared_costs')}
    expected_work['root_option_probes'] += baseline.root_option_probes
    expected_work.update(
        planning_events=path_events + scored.background_planning_events,
        planning_random_draws=path_draws + scored.background_planning_random_draws,
        planning_rate_reads=path_reads + scored.background_planning_rate_reads,
        risk_filtered_candidates=scored.candidate_count - len(permitted),
        risk_feasible_candidates=len(permitted), unconstrained_root_index=unconstrained,
        risk_changed_unconstrained_root=actual != unconstrained)
    assert all(info[key] == value for key, value in expected_work.items()), ('target work', index)
    certificates.append(dict(frame_index=index, start=now, baseline_root=incumbent, actual_root=actual,
        baseline_S1_sum=fraction(scored.costs[incumbent]), actual_S1_sum=fraction(scored.costs[actual]),
        strict_S1_improvement_sum=fraction(scored.costs[incumbent] - scored.costs[actual]),
        baseline_S2_sum=fraction(scored.squared_costs[incumbent]), actual_S2_sum=fraction(scored.squared_costs[actual]),
        S2_nonincrease_sum=fraction(scored.squared_costs[incumbent] - scored.squared_costs[actual]),
        rounded_scores=rounded, exact_S1_strict_improvement=True, exact_S2_nonincrease=True,
        actual_exact_rule_root_matched=True, target_work_metadata_matched=True))

assert certificates, 'expected at least one changed frame with lost float strictness'
print(json.dumps(dict(registered_at_utc=protocol['registered_at_utc'], unit_index=462,
    unit=unit, trajectory_file=trajectory_file.name, prefix_frames_verified=len(saved['result']['frames']),
    eligible_frames_verified=eligible, tagged_events_verified=tagged_events,
    prefix_draws_verified=prefix_draws, prefix_rate_reads_verified=prefix_reads,
    exact_target_frames_verified=len(certificates), certificates=certificates,
    exact_proof_passed=True, all_other_frozen_checks_certified=False,
    new_simulations=0, policy_calls=0, rng_reconstruction_only=True,
    at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()), separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False))
